buildings.name: The Green Table
buildings.description: A neighborhood restaurant where residents can share a meal and meet over a communal table.

buildings.name: Common Ground
buildings.description: A friendly coffee shop with shared tables for coffee, conversation, and meeting fellow residents.

buildings.name: Central Park
buildings.description: The city's central green, with a fountain and park benches for meeting neighbors outdoors.

buildings.name: Willow Park
buildings.description: A leafy neighborhood park with shaded benches and picnic space for relaxed conversations.

buildings.name: Maple Community Garden
buildings.description: Shared garden beds and a communal picnic table where neighbors can meet among the greenery.

buildings.name: Founders Square
buildings.description: An open town square with a fountain and benches, ideal for chance encounters and meeting friends.

buildings.name: Sunset Walk
buildings.description: A tree-lined walking promenade with lookout benches for an afternoon stroll or an evening chat.

buildings.name: Lantern Courtyard
buildings.description: A welcoming courtyard with shared tables and a shaded pergola for casual group hangouts.

buildings.name: New Eden Community Center
buildings.description: A neighborhood gathering hall with a lounge where residents can meet and spend time together.

buildings.name: Little Lantern Library
buildings.description: A cozy public library with a shared reading lounge for quiet visits and conversations with new people.

buildings.name: Olive & Oak Bistro
buildings.description: A neighborhood bistro with communal dining tables, affordable meals, and coffee.

buildings.name: Silverstream Riverbank
buildings.description: A peaceful riverbank lookout beside Silverstream, with flowing water and benches. An optional destination for river watching, quiet reflection or meeting a friend on dry land.

buildings.name: Silverstream Riverside Walk
buildings.description: A riverside walkway with shaded seating beside Silverstream. Choose a leisurely walk here or continue to the nearby riverbank in your free time.

buildings.name: Cloudpeak Mountain Lookout
buildings.description: A mountain viewpoint with rocky peaks and a level resting area at their foot. An optional spot for sightseeing, fresh air and enjoying the mountain scenery.

buildings.name: Pinecrest Hill Station
buildings.description: A leafy hill-station retreat with rolling hills and outdoor lookout seating. Visit for a relaxing break or use it as a stop on a self-chosen trek through the Highlands.

buildings.name: Pine Ridge Trekking Trail
buildings.description: A marked trekking-friendly woodland trailhead with a resting bench. For an optional longer outing, walk between this trail, Pinecrest Hill Station and Cloudpeak Mountain Lookout using MOVE; choose your own pace and rest when needed.

buildings.name: New Eden Galleria
buildings.description: An indoor mall with a bright atrium and communal lounge. An optional place for window-shopping, meeting friends or relaxing out of the rain; browsing requires no purchase.
